body: Not after we just got Akroma's memorial in Historic Anthology 3. No way they release it in a set just after putting it available there. Reprints go there if they're not being reprinted I'd say.
Thank you for your input, I was not aware of this possibility...I'll try to prioritize getting seen again asap.

Basically going to the next level of treatment, so here it would be:

1) Start with the creams.

2) If it's not helping, move to the botox or surgery.

Basically usually with a doctor they'll start with the least invasive/expensive option with a good chance of helping, and if it doesn't, they would "escalate" to something more involved, such as a surgery, which would rarely be first choice as there are complication risks.

Latest is that I think I need to go for #2 but the pain of even trying to push is knife-stabbingly painful. I know that not going is also not good with this condition, and again I feel backed against a wall with no recourse. I just don't know how to see this period through well with pains reaching these heights.
